description: The bar chart illustrates the results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev, representing execution accuracy across various query difficulty levels. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as "Simple", "Moderate", "Challenging", and "Total". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Execution Accuracy", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 20 to 60 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each category contains two bars corresponding to different modules as defined by the legend at the top: "NatSQL" is represented by light blue bars and "TA-SQL" is represented by dark blue bars. Exact numerical values are annotated above each bar. In the "Simple" category, NatSQL scores 60.21 and TA-SQL scores 63.14. For the "Moderate" category, NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60. In the "Challenging" category, NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11. In the "Total" category, NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The shortest bar in the chart is the NatSQL module in the Challenging category with a value of 32.32, while the tallest bar is the TA-SQL module in the Simple category with a value of 63.14. The bars are grouped by category rather than sorted by numerical value, and there are no specific visual emphases such as bolding or outlining applied to the bars.
